note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable form of the task contract; tolerance and global-domain shape constraints are in task.yaml. Hidden/perf cases are {name + semantic fields} dicts: name is a metadata key that the consumer strips, then calls reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields for deterministic generation (consumption order features -> filters -> out_bp -> counts -> in_tab -> out_tab).

shape_family.out_layout: both directions are inherently single-tensor outputs with no concatenation packing: dgrad returns dx (n, c_in); wgrad returns dF (c_out, c_in, kv) contiguous, interpreted with the filters layout mapping -- dF.reshape(c_out, kv, c_in)[o, k, i] = dW_math[o, i, k]
